en.headline: Pass into central box
en.body: Inside the box, centrally, Segun Okafor plays a bold 10.7m pass to Kwabena Asante. The ball is aimed into the penalty area in stoppage time. It raises immediate scoring threat amid a Chaos Index of 92.
